summary.text: Mari Cordes, a Democrat from Lincoln, represented Addison-4 in the Vermont House of Representatives from 2019 until she resigned on June 19, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Cordes earned a B.S. in Natural Resource Management, Economics and Policy and in 1988 graduated with a nursing degree from Vermont College, according to her House biography.

As a registered nurse she co-led a multi-year project to reduce central line bloodstream infections at UVM Medical Center and organized and led medical teams providing disaster relief after the Haiti earthquake and provided medical relief in Greece to refugees.
She was a founding organizer and second president of the Vermont Federation of Nurses and Health Professionals, AFT Local 5221.
Before her election she was appointed to the first Green Mountain Care Board Advisory Council, the Consumer Health Care Council and the Future of Nursing Commission.
She lives with her spouse on an off-the-grid homestead in Lincoln and has two children and two grandchildren.
